	var engineConfig pkg.CrawlConfig
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"browser":{"mode":"never"},"content":{"exclude_selectors":[],"extract_metadata":false,"preprocessing_preset":"minimal","remove_forms":false,"remove_navigation":false},"respect_robots_txt":false}`), &engineConfig); err != nil {

	if createErr != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("create handle failed: %v", createErr))
	}
	url := `https://example.com`
	result, err := pkg.Scrape(engine, url)

	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Markdown.Content)
